source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 838 makes account discovery throw an exception carrying the NSS service error message for a certificate failure when requireGoodCert is true. The current path also logs hostname and port and rejects through its catch/abort path. The relaxed path still delegates to processCertError. Preserve this strict-versus-interactive distinction rather than swallowing the reason or treating every connection failure as a certificate prompt.
title: Reject strict certificate failures with the NSS diagnostic
